description: Bombas is a U.S. comfort-focused sock and apparel brand that makes socks, underwear, t-shirts, slippers and shirts and donates one item for every item purchased. Its Ascend program page says over 200 million essential clothing items have been donated and counting. Its official affiliates page says it works with a network of over 3,500 giving partners across all 50 states.

evidence.summary: Official page: 'Join Bombas' Affiliate Partner Program!' FAQ: 'We offer 10% commission for every sale generated by a new customer & 1% commission for sales from existing customers. Not valid on gift cards.' Joining is free via Ascend, PID #8171, applications reviewed in 3-5 business days. The phrase 'the opportunity to earn is endless' refers to the product range, not an earnings cap — no 'no cap' / 'unlimited earnings' statement is published, so commission_cap is unknown.
Official page publishes: 'Feel free to reach out to affiliates@bombas.com' for additional questions about the affiliate program or partnering with Bombas.
Ascend / Partnerize registration page for the Bombas Socks Affiliate Program with an application form, repeating affiliates@bombas.com and the one-purchased, one-donated model.

name: Bombas

reasons.compensation: Officially published 10% for new customers, reduced to 1% for existing customers, with no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Dedicated official program page, a live application form, and a published affiliates@bombas.com email.
reasons.credibility: Mature U.S. brand with over 200 million items donated per its program page.
reasons.niche_fit: Everyday socks, underwear and apparel basics fit fashion and fitness creators well.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join, applications reviewed within 3-5 business days per the official page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The official program is built for partners promoting on personal social media or blogs, but no creator-count evidence was found.

description: Muscle Nation is a Brisbane, Australia activewear and supplements brand founded in August 2016, selling men's and women's activewear, protein powders, bars and nutritional supplements. It recently launched a new Affiliate Program for creators, with commission on sales, a personal discount link and access to an affiliate community.

evidence.summary: Official Muscle Nation help page: 'We've recently launched our new Affiliate Program which is the best place for creators who are interested in partnering with us!' Perks listed: commission on sales, a personal discount link to share with your audience, and access to the affiliate community; applications are reviewed and followed up by email.

Sovrn Commerce listing: 'Muscle Nation offers an 8% commission per sale through Sovrn Commerce' with a 30-day cookie; joining is 'exclusively through Sovrn Commerce'. No cap / no-cap / unlimited-earnings wording appears anywhere on the page, so commission_cap is unknown, not uncapped.

Saturation evidence for 'low': Beacons Universe (updated November 20, 2026) counts only 109 creators all time and only 3 sponsored posts mentioning Muscle Nation in the last 12 months, and the official help page describes the affiliate program as 'recently launched' — a small, new program.
Lasso independently lists the Muscle Nation affiliate program at 8% per sale with a 30-day cookie, corroborating the Sovrn rate.

name: Barbell Jack
description: Barbell Jack sells a premium barbell jack gym accessory that makes loading and unloading weight plates faster and safer, used by home gyms, commercial facilities, physiotherapists and serious lifters. Its Partner Program is aimed at fitness influencers, coaches, gym owners and content creators.

evidence.summary: Barbell Jack's official Partner Program page states verbatim: 'There is no cap on earnings' and its FAQ answers 'How much commission can I earn?' with 'there is no limit on how much you can earn' — an explicit uncapped statement, so commission_cap is uncapped. The page does not publish an exact commission percentage ('Commission rates are competitive'), so commission_rate is null.

A Barbell Jack Partner Program welcome video published by the brand on Loom states partners receive a 40% discount on their orders, a 10% coupon code for followers, and 'earn a 30% commission on every referral'. This percentage is not published on the official program page, so it is recorded here as reported context only and commission_rate stays null.

The same official page says the program is for 'fitness influencers, gym owners, coaches, content creators, bloggers, and niche websites', that 'No minimum audience size is required', joining is free, and partners get ready-to-use banners, creative assets and real-time tracking. No creator counts are published anywhere fetched, so creator_saturation is unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: A single premium gym accessory for lifters — squarely fitness, though a narrower product than apparel.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A partner program explicitly built for fitness influencers and creators with banners and creative assets, but no published creator counts.
reasons.compensation: Commissions are explicitly uncapped on the brand's own page, but no exact percentage is published there (a brand video reports 30%), so this stays mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated official partner page with a registration route, but no published partnerships email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join with no minimum audience size and promotion starting immediately after approval.
reasons.credibility: Small single-product brand with limited independent coverage.
